neighbours.label: A recurrence opener: 'Each year', 'Every week', 'Every time X,' at the start of a sentence
fire: Each year more students are joining the club.
Every time I hear that song, I smile.
Every week we hold a short meeting.
Each time the door opens, a bell rings.
Each year in the United States, thousands drown.
Every month the rent goes up.
Every time a train passes, the windows shake.
Each week she writes a new column.
quiet: Last year more students joined the club.
When I heard that song, I smiled.
Next week we hold a short meeting.
After the door opened, a bell rang.
This year in the United States, thousands drowned.
Last month the rent went up.
Once a train passed, the windows shook.
Today she wrote a new column.

predictions: Each/Every openers fire on the time word or the comma; one-off time phrases stay quiet.
